name: SuperTuxKart
author: support@kandru.de
description: Dockered SuperTuxKart dedicated server using the official Linux release.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Preparing SuperTuxKart installation..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

apt-get update -y
apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y curl ca-certificates tar gzip xz-utils unzip

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
chown root:root /mnt/server || true

# Install containers often have a tiny /tmp (this previously failed around 100MB).
# Keep all SuperTuxKart files on the server volume.
WORK_DIR="/mnt/server/.stk-install"
rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"
mkdir -p "${WORK_DIR}/extract"
export TMPDIR="${WORK_DIR}"

echo "Disk space on /mnt/server:"
df -h /mnt/server || true

STK_VERSION="${STK_VERSION:-1.5}"

detect_stk_arch() {
    case "$(uname -m)" in
        x86_64) echo "x86_64" ;;
        aarch64|arm64) echo "arm64" ;;
        armv7l|armv6l) echo "armv7" ;;
        i386|i686) echo "x86" ;;
        riscv64) echo "riscv64" ;;
        *)
            echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2
            exit 2
            ;;
    esac
}

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
else
    STK_ARCH="$(detect_stk_arch)"
    DOWNLOAD_LINK="https://github.com/supertuxkart/stk-code/releases/download/${STK_VERSION}/SuperTuxKart-${STK_VERSION}-linux-${STK_ARCH}.tar.gz"
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Downloading and extracting SuperTuxKart..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "source: ${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"
echo "SuperTuxKart needs about 1.5 GiB free on the server volume."

# Free previous game files before unpacking the new archive.
rm -rf /mnt/server/bin /mnt/server/lib /mnt/server/data /mnt/server/run_game.sh

EXTRACT_DIR="${WORK_DIR}/extract"
case "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" in
    *.zip)
        ARCHIVE="${WORK_DIR}/archive.zip"
        curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "${ARCHIVE}" "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}"
        unzip -q -o "${ARCHIVE}" -d "${EXTRACT_DIR}"
        rm -f "${ARCHIVE}"
        ;;
    *)
        curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 "${DOWNLOAD_LINK}" | tar -x -z -f - -C "${EXTRACT_DIR}"
        ;;
esac

# Official archives wrap files in a single SuperTuxKart-*-linux-* directory.
SRC="${EXTRACT_DIR}"
entries=("${EXTRACT_DIR}"/*)
if [ "${#entries[@]}" -eq 1 ] && [ -d "${entries[0]}" ]; then
    SRC="${entries[0]}"
fi

if [ ! -f "${SRC}/bin/supertuxkart" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: archive does not contain bin/supertuxkart"
    find "${EXTRACT_DIR}" -maxdepth 3 -print
    rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"
    exit 1
fi

# Move instead of copy so the volume does not need 2x the game size.
shopt -s dotglob
for item in "${SRC}"/*; do
    name="$(basename "${item}")"
    rm -rf "/mnt/server/${name}"
    mv "${item}" "/mnt/server/${name}"
done
shopt -u dotglob
rm -rf "${WORK_DIR}"

chmod +x /mnt/server/bin/supertuxkart
if [ -f /mnt/server/run_game.sh ]; then
    chmod +x /mnt/server/run_game.sh
fi

if [ ! -x /mnt/server/bin/supertuxkart ]; then
    echo "ERROR: bin/supertuxkart is missing after install."
    ls -la /mnt/server || true
    ls -la /mnt/server/bin || true
    exit 1
fi

echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"
